svg.title: Model-averaged predictive densities under three alternative prior widths
svg.desc: Model-averaged predictive density for a future calibration reading, compared at alternative prior standard deviations 0.5, 2 and 10 with observation standard deviation fixed at 1. The curves include within-model and between-model uncertainty; evidence and posterior model weights are reported separately in the text.
